text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Kris S! Are you free after this? 
Let's throw a party in the Ritto dorm!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My friends back in America thought I'd be 
missing home by now, so they sent a whole 
bunch of snacks! Maybe there's a taste of 
your memories in here too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Pass. I haven't eaten sweets... very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Besides... When I'm around, everyone tends 
to walk on eggshells.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's completely backwards. Aren't 
you the one being considerate here?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Once you're sitting at the 
same table, we're all friends!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So hey, I got a favor to ask ya! This 
party is B.Y.O! We're always on the hunt 
for interesting drinks.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A "best water" that pairs perfectly with 
any sweet... Wouldn't that be amazing? 
What do you think?
